topic: Reverse Light Control Request Parameter Definition
row_semantics: Each row defines a possible value for the parameter and its corresponding meaning.
column_semantics: There is only one column which represents the hexadecimal value of the parameter.

core_conditions.name: 0x0
core_conditions.description: Indicates that the reverse light control request is OFF.

core_conditions.name: 0x1
core_conditions.description: Indicates that the reverse light control request is ON.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the valid values for the ReverseLightCtrlReq parameter, which is used to control the state of the reverse lights (ON or OFF). It can be used in testing to verify that the system correctly interprets and responds to these parameter values.
